title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：peak　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 peak 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the farmer ① reached the peak that no child in the field would have measured, and he said the reaching was the whole of the autumn. The ② peak, meaning the top itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unmeasured in the book; a peak, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ peak in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ peak at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A peak, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the farmer said the measuring is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the peak was the whole of the matter, meaning the height and not the top. The ⑥ peak, meaning the height and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; peak, he said, is either something you reach or the only word that means both a top and a height. He said the height is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ peak had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ peak of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of measuring; peak, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ peak I remember is the top measured in the almanac, which closed in 1974 and is still measured as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ peak, my mother said in 1976, is the only top that improves by being measured; every peak, she said, is a height that has agreed to look like a top. She said the height was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 山顶；高峰（指田垄里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 山顶；高峰（指那座山顶本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：reach the peak 登到这一座山顶
D. n. 山顶；高峰（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 山顶之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的山顶之事）
F. n. 山顶；高峰（指农事历里写到、被测量的那一座）
G. n. 山顶、极致（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 极致（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: reached the peak that no child in the field would have measured
The peak, meaning the top itself and not the basket
the peak at the far fence
the peak was the whole of the matter
the peak had become a line in an almanac
The peak of the whole thing
A peak, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: reach the peak 意为“登到这一座山顶”，1967 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯测量的一座山顶做了一遍。
peak 意为“山顶；高峰”，指那座山顶本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被测量。
peak 意为“山顶；高峰”，指田垄里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
peak 意为“山顶；高峰”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
peak 意为“山顶、极致”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座极致就是那件事的全部。
peak 意为“极致”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座山顶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
peak 意为“山顶；高峰”，指农事历里写到、被测量的那一座，到 1972 年这一座成了农事历里的一行。
peak 意为“山顶之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的山顶之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的测量。
peak 意为“山顶；高峰”，我记得的是农事历里测量过的那一座，1974 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一座。
peak 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，山顶是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的山顶。

items: 1967 年那位农人登到了田垄里没有一位孩子肯测量的一座山顶，他说这一遍才是那个秋天的全部。（reach the peak）
那座山顶，指的是那座山顶本身而不是小小的竹篮，经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被测量。（peak）
那处田垄里每一座山顶旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。（peak）

叔叔说这座极致就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那座山顶。（peak）
